_note: Copy to config.json (gitignored) only to change a default. Defaults: roots = the repo and its VRG-DE parent; browser = the first portable browser next to the repo (tools/chrome, programs/opera-gx, programs/zen-browser), else the system default; terminal = wt when installed, else cmd; claudeCmd = tools/node/claude.cmd, else claude; vscode = tools/vscode/Code.exe, else code; git = tools/git, else git.
